Public identity

Pipeline: Signal -> normalization -> feature extraction -> modality agreement -> evidence grading -> interpretation -> confidence -> limitations -> audit. ## Design rules - Fail closed when evidence is missing. - Separate observable signals from interpretation. - Never infer subjective experience directly from sensor data. - Keep provenance and fingerprints for every result. - Require independent verification before promotion to VERIFIED. - Keep the core deterministic so optional ML/NLP models can be evaluated behind the same contract. - Scheduled production-code mutation is disabled. The layer is model-agnostic: later ML/NLP models can replace individual functions while preserving this evidence contract.
